name: Croatia

fees.name: Schengen short-stay visa (Type C, single/multiple entry)
fees.validity: Stays up to 90 days in any 180-day period
fees.notes: Croatia is a full Schengen member (since Jan 2023). Standard Schengen fee EUR 90; children 6-11 pay EUR 45, under 6 free. Fee waived for family of EU/Croatian citizens, students on school trips, researchers, and other Visa Code categories. Fee is non-refundable if the visa is refused.

fees.name: Schengen short-stay visa (Type C) for business purposes
fees.validity: Stays up to 90 days in any 180-day period
fees.notes: Business travel uses the same Schengen C visa and fee as tourism; only the purpose/supporting documents differ.

fees.name: Airport transit visa (Type A)
fees.applies: nationalities subject to airport transit visa requirement
fees.notes: Same EUR 90 Schengen Visa Code fee applies to airport transit (A) visas.

reciprocity_variations.note: Reduced EUR 35 fee under EU visa facilitation agreements still in force. The former EUR 35 facilitation fee for Russia (and Belarus in part) was suspended by the EU; Russian nationals now pay the standard EUR 90. None of the key nationalities IND/USA/GBR/CHN/NGA/PAK/PHL/BGD/CAN have a differing fee - all pay EUR 90.

vfs.note: Published VFS logistics fee in India is INR 2553 incl. GST (visa fee quoted as INR 10,200 / EUR 90). Service fees vary by country/centre; mandatory two-way courier INR 1332 applies outside New Delhi. Croatia uses VFS Global visa application centres in many countries per MFA notice.

free_visa_notes: Not free in general, but EU/EEA/Swiss citizens and ~90 visa-waiver nationalities enter visa-free. Visa fee waived for children under 6 and Visa Code exemption categories. Croatia has no e-visa, no visa on arrival, and no eTA; ETIAS is not yet operational as of this record date.
